title: Introduction To Comparative Politics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a judge's ability to render decisions free from political or popular influence based solely on the individual facts and applicable law."
Decisional independence refers to a judge's ability to render decisions free from political or popular influence based solely on the individual facts and applicable law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the case study, the statistical method and the comparative method."
The non-experimental methods are the case study, the statistical method and the comparative method.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a useful way to evaluate what we see and hear about the world beyond our shores, as well as about our own society. 2."
Comparison is a useful way to evaluate what we see and hear about the world beyond our shores, as well as about our own society. 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral part of mathematics and computer science."
Logic is an integral part of mathematics and computer science.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the identification of "functional equivalence" of concepts and indications."
The final solution is the identification of "functional equivalence" of concepts and indications.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of political structure widely accepted by scholars as a means for achieving democracy in a political system."
Federalism is a form of political structure widely accepted by scholars as a means for achieving democracy in a political system.
fib: ______ is regarded as the cornerstone of the Rule of law because it facilitates effective application of the Rule of Law.
An independent judiciary is regarded as the cornerstone of the Rule of law because it facilitates effective application of the Rule of Law.
______ is considered one of the purest examples of a consensus system.
Switzerland is considered one of the purest examples of a consensus system.
______ are used, the voting systems tend to allow the voter to vote for a named candidate rather than a party list.

______ is the best method for drawing inferences that have more applicability that is global, for example, the Global Terrorism Index.
Comparing many countries is the best method for drawing inferences that have more applicability that is global, for example, the Global Terrorism Index.

Comparing Few Countries method is a major means of enhancing our understanding of Comparative Politics.

Classification is a necessary component of systematic comparison, but in many ways, it represents a higher level of comparison since it seeks to group many separate descriptive entities into simpler categories.
